mapper.select: select R.no as roomNo, R.host_no as hostNo, R.password as password, R.title as title, R.code as code, R.capacity as capacity, R.created_at as createdAt, R.type as type, R.visibility as visibility, Q.status as status, case when Q.status = 'QUESTION_OPEN' then Q.question_started_at when Q.status = 'VOTING_OPEN' then Q.voting_started_at else null end as phase_started_at, case when Q.status = 'QUESTION_OPEN' then Q.question_ended_at when Q.status = 'VOTING_OPEN' then Q.voting_ended_at else null end as phase_ended_at from room R join qna_room Q on R.no = Q.room_no where Q.room_no = #{roomNo}
select R.no as room_no, Q.status, Q.question_started_at as phase_started_at, Q.question_ended_at as phase_ended_at from room R join qna_room Q on R.no = Q.room_no where Q.room_no = #{roomNo}
select R.no as room_no, Q.status, Q.voting_started_at as phase_started_at, Q.voting_ended_at as phase_ended_at from room R join qna_room Q on R.no = Q.room_no where Q.room_no = #{roomNo}
select room_no, question_started_at, question_ended_at, voting_started_at, voting_ended_at, status from qna_room where room_no = #{roomNo}
mapper.update: update qna_room set voting_started_at=#{startedAt}, voting_ended_at=#{endedAt} where room_no = #{roomNo}
